limits: This restores the configured disposable controller suite, not managed guest disks, a signed production installation or a complete fleet disaster-recovery scenario.
The running lab control service is the retained earlier preview build. This does not establish a combined release of the latest integration branches.

The first backup stopped on a root-owned runtime file. Its cleanup restarted the source services; the corrected backup copied that state through its owning container without changing source permissions.
A first isolated verifier used the wrong filesystem identity. It was corrected to the backup owner; subsequent fresh restoration uses that identity from startup.

A post-startup Redis key comparison encountered normal expiry. A subsequent serialized comparison refused reordered hash encodings; no data-loss conclusion was inferred. Final proof compares immutable logical values and absolute expiries before application writers start.

A canonical preflight refused an unhandled stream type. Stream verification now retains the complete serialized stream and consumer-group state. Failed or partial rehearsals were retained and not counted as passing.
Existing inference endpoints, local CLI sign-in stores and managed hosts remain external. They are not contacted by the isolated restored suite.
All five uncertain native operations remain unknown and held. No recovery lease was cleared, and no production mutation policy was created.
Remaining native interruption cuts, complete authorized recovery, broader AC-01–AC-24 acceptance and the compatible signed release still gate production.
